<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">前言</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广域网络是数据通信网络中尺度最大的一层：向下连接无数局域网，向上支撑互联网与云。本章分上下两篇，回答六个问题<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">什么是广域网、城域网正往哪里演进、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">凭什么成为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">时代的承载网、四大运营商的骨干网各自长什么样、企业广域网如何应对云计算的冲击、广域网未来会走向何方。适合已具备前十四章基础（尤其是以太网、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IP/MPLS<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">相关章节）的读者阅读。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">本章内容概览</span></h2>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一、广域网络概述</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广域网是一切远距离互联的起点。这一节先厘清三个容易混淆的概念：广域网是什么、它和局域网差在哪、它和互联网又是什么关系。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.1 广域网的定义</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广域网（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">Wide Area Network<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">WAN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）是一种大规模的远程通信网络，它将不同区域的局域网相互连接起来，能够连接大量的远程终端与服务，从而实现广泛范围内的信息和资源共享。其覆盖范围从几十千米到几千千米不等，甚至能够跨越国家乃至大洲。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.2 广域网与局域网的区别</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两者最直观的差异体现在地理范围和传输速度上：</span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">对比维度</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广域网</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">局域网</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">地理范围</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">跨越城市、国家甚至国际范围</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">限于家庭、学校、办公楼等小物理区域</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传输速度</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">因带宽限制稍慢，用户多无明显感知</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">速度更快，距离短且拥塞可能性低</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.3 广域网与互联网的关系</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">不少人容易把广域网和互联网混为一谈。实际上，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">互联网是由全球的私有、公共、学术、商业和政府网络组成的超大型广域网，它只是广域网的一种具体形式<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。除了互联网领域，广域网还在运营商、政企等领域发挥着重要作用：企业会建设广域网来连接分支机构或远程员工与总部，大学也会建设广域网实现多校区互联。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.4 广域网的建设模式</span></h3>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">建设模式</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">特点</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">典型场景</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">自建广域网</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">需组织具备极强的网络建设、配置与运维能力，网络完全自主可控</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商的骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域网、铁路数据网、电力数据网</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">租用广域网</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">客户因能力限制或不关注底层网络实现，选择全部或部分租用</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">大型连锁商超、银行证券企业的业务网络；初创公司办公网络、业务数据上云的公司网络</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1.5 广域网的优缺点</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">优点<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：连接范围广，可连接远距离用户实现资源共享；资源集中集约，支持任意地点接入，服务器等资源便于维护管理；可扩展性强，按需扩展分支站点无需重建。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">缺点<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：网络复杂，涉及协议技术多，需专业人员规划运维；建设使用成本高，涉及长距链路建设<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">租用及专业运维投入；安全管理要求高，长距链路和公网传输增加数据泄露风险，管控难度大。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">二、运营商城域网络：新型城域网的关键技术</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域网是广域网体系中最贴近用户的一层。随着<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与云业务的到来，传统城域网已经力不从心，我国运营商正沿<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新型城域网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">两条路线演进。本节聚焦新型城域网。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2.1 城域网的定义与发展趋势</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域网依据<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IEEE 802.6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">标准构建，是覆盖城市或特定区域的计算机通信网络，由运营商建设管理，提供高速安全的网络服务。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">随着信息技术发展，传统城域网架构与技术难以满足数据传输需求增长及网络智能化趋势，架构演进与新技术引入至关重要。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2.2 新型城域网的驱动因素</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">过去十年，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2G/3G/4G/5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络并存导致运营商运营成本（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">OPEX<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）持续上升，网络面临结构性问题：多代网络同网承载，使网络、业务及运维复杂度大幅提升，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">降低 OPEX 已成为全球运营商的共识<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新的承载网络需要满足五方面需求：全业务承载（满足<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2C <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向消费者、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2B <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向企业、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2H <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向家庭多业务的快速高效接入与承载）；基础资源统一（实现中心局<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CO<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、管道光缆、光交<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分纤点等基础资源统一，支撑统一综合接入及<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">光设备网络高效组网）；个性化的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">需求；便捷、快速的云连接需求；智能化的网络管理需求。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2.3 SRv6：新型城域网的技术底座</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">继承了<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SR-MPLS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">源路由编程的优势，并具备原生<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IPv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的天然兼容性和可扩展性。在此基础上，还衍生出网络切片、随流检测（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IFIT<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）等<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"IPv6+"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术。部署方案按网络规模分为两种：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">部署方案</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="192">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">适用场景</span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">实现端到端的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> VPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务承载</span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">整体承载方案以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SRv6 + EVPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">为协议底座，配合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IFIT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> iMaster NCE-IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">四大关键技术，在同一张网上同时满足<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> URLLC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（低时延）、专线（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">保障）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">eMBB<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（大带宽）等差异化业务：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="424" height="340.3430971128609" id="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625834-1420000625.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">E2E VPN/HoVPN over SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络承载解决方案总体框架图</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2.4 FlexE 网络切片与 IFIT 随流检测</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> HoVPN over SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">方案中，网络切片通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IGP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">设计（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IS-ISv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多进程）与隧道设计（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SRv6 BE / SRv6 Policy<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）实现，物理层依托<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">信道化子接口划分<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">缺省切片<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（承载<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务等）与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">行业切片<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（承载<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">低时延业务），接入带宽按<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 50G<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、核心按<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 100G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">规划：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="334.4204724409449" id="2" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625879-2098469390.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">HoVPN over SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络切片方案示意图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">随流检测<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IFIT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">则解决<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务质量看得见<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的问题：对<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> E2E <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务进行<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">坚持监测，一旦发现质差业务，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">iFIT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">逐跳定界，快速定位问题网段：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="428" height="340.39769028871393" id="3" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625862-1155258149.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IFIT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">工作流示意图</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2.5 iMaster NCE-IP 智能管控</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">iMaster NCE-IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">内嵌<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算法及<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"IPv6+"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术，通过网络数字地图实现物理网络的数字化管理，助力行业数字化转型。其关键技术包括：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多维度数字化可视<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：包含底图图层、网络图层、网络信息图层、网络业务图层和应用图层，满足不同客户诉求；</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多因子云图算法<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> BGP-LS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">协议获取拓扑与带宽资源，实现多业务路径的调度；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能故障分析算法<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：引入<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与流式框架，实时聚类与根因识别；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">BGP 路由安全分析<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：监控全量及重保<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> BGP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">路由，识别异常并告警。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三、运营商城域网络：SPN 关键技术解析</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新型城域网之外，另一条演进路线是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（切片分组网）。这一节从承载网的三代演进讲起，看清<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">凭什么胜出，再拆解它的架构模型与四大关键技术。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3.1 承载网三代演进：SDH → PTN → SPN</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">承载网的发展以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SDH<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（同步数字系列）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ PTN<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（分组传送网）<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">→ SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">为主线。业务需求从单一的、固定的语音业务，转向多元化的、突发的、高质量的数据业务，驱动着承载网技术不断革新。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">

<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术定位</span></p>
</td>

</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">适应<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">化的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分组软化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">更适合<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务且多业务统一承载</span></span></span></span></span></p>

<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="144">

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3.2 SPN 网络架构</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域综合组网自下而上分为接入、综合接入、普通汇聚、骨干汇聚、城域核心五个层级，向下连接<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> gNodeB/AAU<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，向上对接核心网部分的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> UP/MEC/CU<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="370" height="339.74845144356954" id="4" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625849-306951853.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域综合组网结构</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构模型自上而下分为三层：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">切片分组层<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">承载<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> L2/L3 VPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CBR <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务，通过分组隧道（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SR-TP/SR-BE/MPLS-TP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">层完成业务封装；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">切片通道层<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Slicing Ethernet<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）提供；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">切片传送层<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">由<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OIF FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IEEE 802.3 PHY <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">构成。时间<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">时钟与管理<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制作为两个纵向平面贯穿三层：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="483" height="339.78488188976377" id="5" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625829-460740369.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构模型</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3.3 SPN 四大关键技术</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的技术体系可以概括为四项关键技术，分别解决带宽、时延、切片与管控问题：</span></span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">关键技术</span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">核心作用</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术和以太网接口技术</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">带宽的基石</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分组切片技术</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">实现硬切片与确定低时延</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">灵活硬切片技术</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">构建高效灵活的网络切片</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术</span></span></span></p>
</td>
<td rowspan="1" colspan="1" width="288">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能管控析</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（1）FlexE 技术和以太网接口技术——带宽的基石。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太网接口技术应用广泛、产业链成熟，高速率接口发展迅速。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IEEE 802.3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基础上引入<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE Shim <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">层，实现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MAC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PHY<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（物理）层的解耦，进而实现灵活多速率接口，支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 50GE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">100GE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">200GE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">400GE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">等高速率，支撑低成本大带宽建网。高速以太网接口的两项代表性技术：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FEC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">采用成熟的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> KP4 FEC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">实现长距离传输；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">PAM4<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">级脉冲幅度调制）在波特率不变的情况下使数据速率翻倍，有效降低光接口成本。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">还通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">绑定与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DWDM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多波长技术融合实现带宽的灵活扩展和分割<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">链路捆绑技术能在不调整业务的情况下实现带宽平滑扩容，例如<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 50GE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">链路可无感知扩容到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> N×50GE<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 200GE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太网绑定即可实现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 800GE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">带宽的管道容量。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（2）FlexE 分组切片技术——硬切片与确定低时延。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">超低时延是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务的重要要求，传统分组网络逐包发送的机制时延较高。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分组切片采用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">严格 TDM 调度机制替代逐包发送机制<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，基于时隙调度实现刚性隔离、带宽独占。通常所说的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OIF<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（光互联网论坛）定义的接口级切片能力；随着<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的发展，其还支持<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ITU-T <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">定义的更完善切片技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> G.mtn<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，在<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基础上增强了<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OAM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">特性和交叉特性。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（3）SPN 灵活硬切片技术。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">可同时提供<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">高可靠硬隔离的硬切片<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">弹性可扩展的软切片<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">能力：通过<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MTN TDM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通道实现切片硬隔离，通过以太网包交换通道实现基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SR <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的包交换通道，再利用<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QoS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术实现切片软隔离，为多种业务提供差异化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SLA<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MTN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的关键技术包括：基于以太网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 64/66B <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">码块的交叉技术（极低转发时延与良好隔离）、按需端到端<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> OAM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">技术（基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IEEE 802.3 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">码块扩展及<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IDLE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">替换原理）、基于以太网业务透明映射技术（通过转码机制实现各类业务到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MTN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">通道的透明映射）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（4）SDN 技术——智能管控析。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">引入<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">理念后可实时监测网络状态、触发网络自寻优。管控析体现在三个方面：管理方面，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">控制器与设备分工实现业务自动化部署调优（自动化配置<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NETCONF/YANG<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、实时性能监控<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Telemetry<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）；控制方面，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SR-TP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">重路由技术解决网络多点故障问题；分析方面，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IFIT <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">方式直接检测报文，实现业务级<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">精准可视。统一<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Web Portal <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与开放<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> API <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网关之上，一张网络可同时承载<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G 2C <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">业务切片、医疗切片、政务切片等多种业务：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="493" height="339.91055118110233" id="6" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625882-1275161450.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能管控平台</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">四、运营商骨干网：定义、分类与演进驱动</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">看完了最贴近用户的城域网，我们把视线转向顶层<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网。它决定了省与省、国与国之间数据如何流动。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4.1 骨干网的定义与分类</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商骨干网是连接多个区域的高速数据通信网络，位于运营商整体网络结构的顶层核心位置，提供跨城市、区域、省份、运营商及国家的数据传输与交换服务，覆盖范围可达几十至几千千米。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">按服务范围，骨干网分为三类：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">国家骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">负责各省之间的网络互联和国际连接；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">省内骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">负责省内各地市之间的连接；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">专注于云服务领域，负责<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">上云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云间<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">数据传输，是云专网的核心组成部分。从城域网的视角看，是否设置省内骨干网，形成了<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">省内骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">省间骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的三级或两级组网结构：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="149.63118110236218" id="7" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625807-1119259315.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 7<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　运营商骨干网分类及组网结构</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">4.2 骨干网的发展驱动因素</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网的持续演进由三股力量推动：一是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">流量增长<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">互联网快速发展使用户数量和业务需求不断增加，网络流量呈爆炸式增长，骨干网必须持续提升容量和性能；二是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新业务新技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——5G<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、物联网、人工智能等对骨干网的功能和性能提出更高要求；三是<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商重组拆分<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网的结构和资源分配随之调整优化，同时也影响市场竞争格局。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">五、四大运营商骨干网的发展历程与架构现状</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">中国四大运营商的骨干网各有前世今生。本节逐一梳理电信、联通、移动、广电的建设脉络与当前架构，这是理解中国互联网格局的基础。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.1 中国电信：从 ChinaNet 到三张全国骨干网</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">中国电信的骨干网建设经历了五个关键节点：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ChinaNet 早期架构<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：早期各省公司独立建设省内<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网，之后形成省间骨干网、省内骨干网和城域网三级结构，省间骨干网又细分为核心层与汇聚层；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">ChinaNet 带宽提升<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：带宽从<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 155Mbps <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">逐步提升至<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 10Gbps<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，进而向单波<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 400Gbps <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">迈进；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络扁平化优化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2003 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年推行扁平化优化整合，取消省骨干网，架构从三级转为骨干网与城域网两级，骨干网接入节点下沉至各省会及主要地市；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CN2 骨干网建设<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2004 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年启动，作为第二张骨干网主要服务于政企高端业务、大客户互联网专线等，具备扁平化、大容量、轻载运行特点；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CN2-DCI 骨干网建设<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2015 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年开始建设第三张全国骨干网，强化数据中心互联、适配云服务需求。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">当前中国电信的骨干网格局呈现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多网并存<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<table>

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.2 中国联通：三张网的合与分</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"China 169" 网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：联通骨干网始于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1994 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年，初期主营<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> GSM <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">移动通信业务，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 3G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">演进后开始建设骨干网作为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> GPRS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络接入点；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1997 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年建成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"169 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，价格低廉，深受普通网民青睐，后经多次重组形成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"China 169"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">联通 A 网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">1999 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年中国网通成立并建成骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CNCNET<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2008 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年联通与网通合并后<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CNCNET <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">交由联通运营，后称<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">联通<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> A <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">（现<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CUII<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">），主要承载原网通<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> NGN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">软交换、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">DCN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">等业务，定位类似电信<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CN2<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，主要提供国际国内<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MPLS VPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与互联网专线，面向政企与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IDC <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">客户，极少用于家庭宽带；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">联通 B 网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：联通早年建设的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">承载网，主要承载<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2G/3G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">移动网业务，设备数量多但容量较小，随业务逐步迁移至<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> A <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网，该承载网渐被弃用。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">其中<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> China 169 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的核心前身为原邮电部建设的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"169 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，采用私有地址；经<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 2002 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年电信重组，北方十省电信与吉通等合并为中国网通并继承此网络，<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2008 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年联通与网通合并后最终由新联通接管运营。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.3 中国移动：CMNET、IP 专网与云专网</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CMNET<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2000 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年中国移动从中国电信分离并挂牌运营，后建设自有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CMNET<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。它是移动<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> GPRS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络两大接入点之一，由骨干网和省网两级自治域、多层结构组成，承载安全性与质量要求较低的普通公众互联网业务（家庭宽带、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">WLAN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">等），架构由核心层、接入层、网间互联层组成；</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IP 专网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：承载高价值客户业务，涵盖话音、流媒体等，采用核心、汇聚、接入三层结构与单一自治域；现承载安全等级高、需业务隔离的业务（自有语音、信令数据等），覆盖全国<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 31 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">省，骨干网含核心层与汇聚层；</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">●&nbsp;<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云专网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：为适配云业务发展建设，聚焦<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DCI<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、企业上云及互联专线业务，实现算力枢纽节点互联及低时延互访；架构包含<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PON + <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">城域网、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CMNET <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">省网、省内云骨干，且省内云骨干正逐步整合至集团云骨干，未来城域网将直连集团云骨干。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.4 中国广电：5G 国干网与 CBNET</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">中国广电的发展分为三步：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">2018 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">年获得骨干网运营资质；随后启动<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5G 国干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">建设，主要承载移动语音和信令业务；再建设 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CBNET 骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">定位全国性<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">骨干网，提供固定与移动业务互联网访问、广电大视频分发及企业业务承载。<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CBNET <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> Native IPv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">单栈承载双栈业务，并以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> EVPN over SRv6 BE/Policy<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">MVPN over BIER6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">等协议实例，同时划分文化专网切片、互联网切片、视频分发切片、集客专线切片等多种业务切片：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span class="image-wrapper"><img width="548" height="319.6666666666667" id="8" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2248264/202610/2248264-20261022104625858-1410792724.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-center"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">图<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 8<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">　<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">CBNET <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">5.5 骨干网面临的四大挑战</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">面向未来，骨干网仍需解决四方面问题：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络架构优化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">进一步简化架构、推进扁平化，优化故障场景下的流量路径，缩短时延、提升可靠性与保护能力；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">转发效率提升<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">部分局向捆绑链路过多导致流量调度精度不足，需提升接口带宽、解除链路组耦合，实现精准算路与调优；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">容量扩容需求<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——AI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与计算业务流量激增，需依据业务流量模型与流向合理扩容链路带宽与设备容量；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新技术部署<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">加快<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SRv6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、网络切片、随流检测等新技术应用，实现路径灵活规划、流量实时调优、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">确定性保障及传输质量检测与故障修复。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">六、企业广域网：云时代的架构重构</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商的网络在演进，企业侧的广域网同样在剧变。云计算把应用从本地搬到了云端，传统基于<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> MPLS <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的企业广域网已经难以招架。</span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6.1 传统企业广域网络的四大挑战</span></h3>

<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">6.2 华为云广域网解决方案</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">华为云广域网解决方案构建<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">园区边界<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云广域骨干网络<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">—<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云边界<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的云广域网架构，以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> iMaster NCE-IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">为管控中枢，智能云广域网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">联接各类分支，云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> PE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">打通公有云与云<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> DC<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">七、广域网络的未来演进</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">最后展望未来。广域网的演进可以概括为五条主线：更宽、更深、更广、更强、更智能。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7.1 更宽：接口向 3.2T 高速演进</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">光接口技术迭代周期不断缩短：从<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 400G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">光接口普及，到<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 800G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">接口快速渗透，目前已向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 1.6T<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3.2T <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">演进。高速接口将极大提升广域网传输能力，满足高清视频、大数据传输等高带宽业务需求。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7.2 更深：深度渗透工业领域</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">尽力而为<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">的网络架构无法满足工业互联网需求，工业领域需要差异化<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">和确定性网络<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">能源领域的无人机巡检、交通领域的高铁列控调度都对网络的灵活性和带宽有较高要求。广域网采用的<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">大颗粒、小颗粒及子通道切片技术，通过资源隔离确保带宽与时延确定性，且带宽灵活性优于传统技术。未来广域网将具备时间、资源、路径确定性，突破工业领域应用瓶颈。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7.3 更广：构建空天地一体的泛在互联网络</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">用户希望随时随地接入网络，空天地一体网络将地面网络与卫星网络有机结合，提供更广泛的覆盖。其部署面临网络拓扑动态变化、覆盖难题和安全风险等挑战，需要研发时变拓扑路由协议、提升覆盖效率并构建内生安全架构。</span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7.4 更强：发展可信与量子安全网络</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">传统网络安全侧重边界防御，已无法满足现代需求。可信网络需要具备<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">安全性、韧性和可靠性<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">三大关键属性，将安全融入基础设施，构建纵深防御体系。同时，量子计算对传统密码算法构成威胁，应对技术主要有后量子密码学和量子密钥分发（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">QKD<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">目前全球已部署多个<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> QKD <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">量子保密通信网络，未来将向高码率、长距离、大规模商业化发展。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 3"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">7.5 更智能：推进网算云融合的算力网络建设</span></h3>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">算力是设备的核心能力，物联网数据激增使云计算瓶颈凸显。算力网络作为新型信息基础设施，可在云、边、端之间按需分配调度计算、存储、网络资源，提升计算协同效率；它连接数据、算力与智能，将推动物联网、人工智能等技术的发展，促进各行业的数字化转型和智能化升级。</span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">本章总结</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">1.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">广域网概念<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：大规模远程通信网络，将不同区域的局域网相互连接，实现广泛范围内的信息与资源共享；建设模式分自建与租用两类。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">2.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商城域网络两大架构<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：新型城域网与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网络。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">3.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新型城域网部署方案<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">E2E VPN over SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">适合中小型网络；<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">HoVPN over SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">更适合大型或跨域网络，以分层模型减轻核心设备压力。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">4.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">新型城域网关键技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SRv6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、网络切片、随流检测（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">IFIT<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">）与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> iMaster NCE-IP<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">5.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN 架构模型<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：切片分组层、切片通道层、切片传送层三层结构。</span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">6.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN 关键技术<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">以太网接口技术（带宽基石）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">FlexE <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">分组切片（硬切片与确定低时延）、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">灵活硬切片、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SDN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">智能管控析。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">7.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">运营商骨干网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：分国家骨干网、省内骨干网、云骨干网三类；电信形成<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> ChinaNet/CN2/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">全光骨干<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/DCI <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">多网格局，联通有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> China 169 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> A/B <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">网，移动有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CMNET/IP <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">专网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">/<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">云专网，广电有<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> 5G <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">国干网与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> CBNET<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">8.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">企业广域网<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：面对灵活性差、<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">SLA <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">难保障、利用率不均衡、运维复杂四大挑战，以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SRv6<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">、网络切片、智能云图算法、随流检测构建云广域网。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left">9.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">未来演进<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">：沿着更宽（<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">3.2T <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">接口）、更深（工业确定性网络）、更广（空天地一体）、更强（可信与量子安全）、更智能（算力网络）的路径全面演进。</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="paragraph text-align-type-left tco-title-heading 2"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">结语</span></h2>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="微软雅黑">从广域网的基本概念出发，本章完成了一次自内而外的全景扫描：城域网以<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SRv6 <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">与<span data-font-family="微软雅黑"> SPN <span data-font-family="微软雅黑">为双引擎走向<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">一网承载万业务<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">"<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">，骨干网在四大运营商手中各自演化出多条全国性网络，企业广域网则借云之力重构为云广域网。设备层面的硬软件创新（前几章的交换、转发、芯片）最终都要落到这张大网上才能产生价值<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">——<span data-font-family="微软雅黑">而这张大网自己的下一步，是朝着更宽的管道、更确定的时延、更泛在的覆盖与更智能的调度继续生长。理解了广域网，也就理解了数据通信产业的完整版图。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</div>

</div>
